searchText: Is there a testnet for EIP1559? Is there currently any way for a wallet/client connecting to an RPC to identify whether a given evm network supports eip-1559? there is one under active development. And the performance testnet has been shutdown. But if there is a need for a wide audience i can set up one No, not yet. Would it be useful ? Hi, is there an implementation guide on 1559 transaction pool? As I understand, by promoting legacy transaction type to 1559 transaction type, we are able to have only one transaction pool. But, instead of sorting the pending transactions list only when new transaction arrives (based on the fact that sorting criteria is gas price), now with 1559 we have to sort the transactions list regardless if new transaction arrived or not (based on the fact that sorting criteria now is miner bribe which is dynamic value which changes with each new block). So, is this new sorting mechanism part of the consensus or every client needs to develop its own logic? Each client can implement their own sorting mechanism. I believe the most common planned strategy is to just resort the transaction list periodically (every few seconds). I think Geth already does this anyway IIRC. Micah, tnx alot <@!543900561460822016> is working on the geth implementation, but it's still in progress. I suspect we'll be ready to share it publicly in a few weeks! This means that https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/21971 is outdated? Yes, it is based on an old specification. Thanks for flagging, I've asked the geth team to close it so people don't get confused 👍
